title: Marketer
description:
GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER



Growth & Customer Acquisition Manager — HVAC & Electrical



We are looking for an independent Growth Marketing Manager who will take ownership of the company's entire marketing function: strategy, paid and organic channels, content, and analytics. The primary result of this role is new customers, collected revenue, and profit. Not posts, not impressions, not reports



Compensation is a percentage of the revenue generated by the marketing system you build. There is no income cap.



============================================================

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

============================================================



Someone who thinks like an entrepreneur and treats every company advertising dollar as their own. Someone who understands marketing, sales, and unit economics. You develop the plan, you execute it, you shut down what does not work and scale what does. You do not wait for instructions.



Technically, this is a strong generalist who uses AI to cover the workload that previously required several separate specialists: performance, SEO, content, video, and analytics.



============================================================

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

============================================================



Overall practical experience in digital / growth marketing: 5+ years, including at least 2 years independently developing and executing growth strategy.



By area:



- Performance marketing and customer acquisition with responsibility for budget and results: 3+ years

- Google Ads — independently managing campaigns and budgets: 3+ years

- SEO and Local SEO (preferably for local service businesses): 3+ years

- Google Business Profile / Google Maps: 3+ years

- Marketing analytics, tracking, attribution, ROAS / CAC / CPL: 3+ years

- Meta / Instagram Ads and short-form content: 2+ years

- Video marketing, YouTube, content production: 2+ years

- Yelp and other local lead-gen platforms: preferably 2+ years

- AI tools in marketing (research, copy, image/video generation, automation): 2+ years, or demonstrated advanced ability with fewer years



Years alone are not what matters. The candidate must show concrete results from previous projects: budget, leads, CAC, ROAS, sales, and collected revenue. See the Proof of Experience section below.



============================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

============================================================



1. STRATEGY AND GROWTH PLAN



Independently analyze the market and competitors, develop a customer acquisition plan, present it to management, and execute it. The plan covers every channel (SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads, Meta, Yelp, YouTube, content, referrals, partnerships, existing customer base marketing), new territories, locations, and services, as well as targets for CPL, CAC, conversion rate, average ticket, ROAS, and profitability.



2. MAXIMUM RESULTS WITH MINIMUM BUDGET



Increasing the advertising budget is not a strategy. Before asking for more ad spend, the manager must look for growth elsewhere: improve the offer, creatives, and landing pages; raise conversion rate and lead quality; reduce CPL and CAC; grow organic traffic, average ticket, repeat business, and referrals.



The long-term objective is marketing assets (Google Maps, SEO, content, reviews, customer base) that bring in customers without advertising costs growing proportionally.



3. PAID CHANNELS



Google Ads. Building and auditing campaigns; Search, Remarketing, Performance Max, and YouTube Ads when economically justified. Keyword management, negative keywords, search term analysis, ad copy, landing pages, conversion and call tracking, A/B testing of offers. Optimization for CPL, CAC, ROAS, and profit — not clicks.



Meta / Instagram. Strategy, original creatives, Reels, Stories, testing audiences, offers, and messaging, campaign management, organic reach growth. Every piece of content has a purpose: Attention → Trust → Lead → Customer → Revenue.



Yelp. Profiles for real locations, optimization, review responses, Yelp Ads only when the economics work. If the channel does not deliver customers at an acceptable cost, the manager recommends reducing or reallocating the budget.



4. ORGANIC CHANNELS



SEO. Strategy, technical audit, keyword and competitor research, service pages and legitimate city / service-area pages, site structure, SEO content, internal linking, backlinks, indexing and ranking monitoring. Success is measured not by the number of pages, but by calls, customers, and revenue from organic search.



Google Business Profile / Google Maps. Creating and verifying profiles only for real locations in compliance with Google requirements, full optimization, regular updates, photos and videos, a legitimate strategy for growing the quantity and quality of reviews, review responses, local ranking and competitor analysis. Each profile is a separate channel with its own tracking of calls, leads, and revenue.



YouTube. An educational channel and a long-term asset: concepts, scripts, Shorts, AI video, voice-over, editing, project and educational videos. Not treated as a source of quick ROI.



5. CONTENT



Content from every project. Every completed job is a marketing asset. We need a system that turns real projects into before / after content, Reels, Shorts, YouTube videos, case studies, and content for GBP, the website, SEO, and ad creatives. One project — multiple pieces of content for multiple platforms, using AI for speed and lower cost.



Educational content. The company should become a source of useful information for homeowners: why an air conditioner is not cooling, repair vs. replace, how to choose a heat pump, how equipment is sized, when an electrical panel upgrade is needed, why permits and inspections matter, how to compare contractor estimates, what not to save money on. The chain: Educate → Build Trust → Create Demand → Generate Leads → Generate Revenue. A person may not be looking for anything today — but when they need us, they will remember us.



Viral content. Systematically create and test material people want to share: unusual HVAC and electrical problems, breakdowns of bad installations, contractor and homeowner mistakes, myths, equipment comparisons, experiments, answers to common questions. Nobody can guarantee every video goes viral — the job is systematic work on ideas with high reach potential.



Our content must be different. Thousands of contractors publish the same thing: "Call us for all your HVAC needs." We do not need that. The constant question: why would someone watch our content? It must be original, useful, easy for a homeowner to understand, visually recognizable, and interesting even to someone who is not buying anything right now. The goal is our own media style and brand voice.



6. AI AS A WORKING TOOL



Professional use of modern AI tools for research and competitor analysis, copywriting, image and video generation, editing, AI avatars and voice-over, scripts, creatives, landing pages, SEO analysis, content repurposing, analytics, and automation. AI makes production faster and cheaper, but it does not replace strategic thinking, originality, fact-checking, or responsibility for results.



7. ANALYTICS AND FULL-FUNNEL RESPONSIBILITY



The manager owns the entire customer journey:



>> Strategy → Attention → Lead → Appointment → Customer → Sale → Payment → Collected Revenue



To do this, they build and maintain attribution: CRM, call tracking, unique phone numbers, conversion and website tracking, Google Analytics, tracking across Google Ads, GBP, Yelp, Meta, YouTube, and landing pages. The company must know the source of every customer.



A report like "Google Ads generated 100 leads" is not enough. We want to see:



>> Marketing Spend → Leads → Qualified Leads → Appointments → Customers → Sales → Collected Revenue → Profit



If there are leads but no customers, the manager finds exactly where the funnel breaks (traffic quality, offer, website, response time, call handling, qualification, scheduling, sales, pricing, follow-up) and proposes a measurable solution.



============================================================

KPI

============================================================



New and qualified leads, new customers, CPL, CAC, Lead → Customer conversion rate, jobs sold, average ticket, collected revenue, ROAS, Marketing ROI, profitability, organic acquisition growth.



The number of posts, videos, views, impressions, and clicks is not the final result.



On ROAS: $10,000 in advertising → $50,000 in collected revenue = ROAS 5x. But ROAS alone does not equal profit. The manager accounts for job costs, gross margin, CAC, refunds, chargebacks, and all marketing expenses. The goal is not an impressive number, but profitable growth.



============================================================

COMPENSATION

============================================================



The primary model is a percentage of revenue actually collected by the company from new customers that can be objectively attributed to marketing channels created or managed by the Growth Marketing Manager. There is no income cap: the company earns more → the manager earns more.



Commission is paid only on money the company has actually received. Not included: unsigned and unpaid estimates, unpaid invoices, canceled jobs, refunds and chargebacks, existing customers without a confirmed new source, personal referrals outside the marketing system, repeat business (unless separately agreed).



Customer source is confirmed through CRM, call tracking, unique phone numbers, website tracking, platforms (Google Ads, GBP, Yelp, Meta, YouTube), landing pages, and other pre-agreed attribution systems.



============================================================

PROOF OF EXPERIENCE

============================================================



During selection, the candidate must show real projects with numbers: what business, the starting situation, budget, number of leads and customers, CPL, CAC, ROAS, collected revenue, which organic channels were built, what did not work and why, and what the candidate did personally.



"I increased brand awareness" and "I managed social media" are not proof of experience. The format: Problem → Action → Numbers → Result.



============================================================

WHO THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR

============================================================



Anyone who measures success by the number of posts, clicks, and impressions; solves every problem by increasing the budget; does not work with analytics; waits for instructions and avoids decisions; is not ready to own a measurable result; does not use AI professionally; produces the same generic content as every other contractor; cannot explain how their work turns into customers, revenue, and profit.



============================================================

CORE PRINCIPLE

============================================================



The Growth Marketing Manager can answer at any moment: how much we spent, how many qualified leads and new customers we got, what one customer cost, how much revenue they brought, which channels are profitable, what to scale, what to shut down — and how to get more customers without proportionally increasing the budget.



The job is to build a marketing system that over time becomes stronger, more recognizable, more organic, cheaper, and more profitable.



The ultimate result: the maximum number of profitable customers with the minimum necessary marketing budget.

title: Remote Service Operations & Project Coordinator — HVAC / Electrical

Remote Service Operations & Project Coordinator — HVAC / Electrical



We are a U.S.-based HVAC and Electrical service company looking for a reliable, highly organized, and proactive Remote Service Operations & Project Coordinator.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or call-center position.



We need someone who can take responsibility for the administrative and coordination side of our customer jobs and projects — from the moment a customer contacts us until the work, inspection, and follow-up are completed.



Your main responsibility is simple:



Make sure every customer request and every active project keeps moving forward without the owner having to constantly call people, chase information, or remind you what needs to be done.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Managing incoming customer requests and active jobs

* Scheduling service calls, installations, follow-up visits, and inspections

* Managing and updating the company calendar

* Communicating with customers by phone, text, and email

* Confirming appointments and arrival windows

* Rescheduling appointments when necessary

* Following up with customers regarding estimates, approvals, scheduling, and project status

* Answering customer questions related to scheduling and project coordination

* Handling routine customer concerns and finding solutions

* Keeping customers informed when schedules, equipment deliveries, or project timelines change

* Calling suppliers and distributors

* Checking equipment and material availability

* Requesting pricing and order information

* Tracking equipment and material orders

* Confirming delivery dates and pickup availability

* Coordinating deliveries and pickups with technicians

* Communicating with technicians and installers regarding schedules and project requirements

* Making sure technicians have the information needed before arriving at a job

* Coordinating permit and inspection scheduling

* Contacting cities, counties, inspectors, utilities, and other organizations when necessary

* Scheduling inspections with customers and field teams

* Tracking inspection results and required follow-up

* Following up on unfinished jobs and open customer requests

* Monitoring estimates and contacting customers when follow-up is required

* Collecting missing information, photos, documents, model numbers, or other project details

* Updating job notes and customer information in the CRM

* Making sure no customer request or project is forgotten or left without a next action



What We Expect



We are looking for someone who does not wait to be told every individual step.



For example:



If equipment is expected to arrive tomorrow, you should check the status before the installation.



If the supplier says the equipment is delayed, you should determine the new ETA, communicate with the customer, coordinate with the field team, adjust the schedule if necessary, and update the CRM.



The owner should not have to ask:



“Did you call them?”



You should already know what needs to be followed up on.



Required Skills



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong phone communication skills

* Excellent organization

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to manage many jobs and conversations at the same time

* Ability to follow up consistently

* Ability to solve routine problems independently

* Comfortable making phone calls throughout the day

* Comfortable speaking with customers, technicians, suppliers, inspectors, and government offices

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Quiet professional workspace

* Ability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



* HVAC

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* Construction

* Home services

* Property management

* Service dispatching

* Project coordination

* Construction administration

* Customer service for U.S. companies



Experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldEdge, or similar field-service software is a major advantage.



Work Schedule



Full-time remote position.



Schedule will generally follow California / Pacific Time business hours.



You must be comfortable working those hours consistently.



Compensation



Starting compensation depends on experience.



Expected starting range:



$4–$6 USD per hour



Strong performers who demonstrate independence, reliability, excellent customer communication, and the ability to manage projects with minimal supervision can earn more.



Who Will Be Successful in This Position



You may be a good fit if you are the type of person who:



* notices problems before someone points them out;

* likes keeping things organized;

* follows up until an issue is actually resolved;

* is comfortable calling people instead of waiting for email replies;

* does not forget unfinished tasks;

* takes ownership of responsibilities;

* can communicate professionally with demanding customers;

* stays calm when schedules change;

* can determine what needs to happen next without waiting for detailed instructions.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the team, not someone looking for a temporary side job.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous experience with U.S. customers.

3. Any HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Construction, or Home Services experience.

4. Any experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, or similar software.

5. Your current hourly rate.

6. Your availability during U.S. Pacific Time.

7. A 1–2 minute voice recording in English introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this position.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
Influencer Marketing Specialist

Location: Philippines / Remote

Employment Type: Full-time



Job Overview:

We are looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to support our influencer marketing and KOL partnership initiatives. This role will be responsible for identifying suitable influencers, managing outreach, coordinating content production, reviewing campaign performance, and helping build a sustainable influencer resource pool for our platform.

We are open to both execution-level and more experienced candidates. Candidates with small team management experience or the ability to lead influencer marketing projects independently will be highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

1. Influencer Research & Resource Development

- Independently search for and identify suitable influencers/KOLs based on our platform’s business needs, target audience, and campaign goals.

- Cover major social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and
.

- Build and maintain an influencer database, including account information, content style, audience profile, engagement rate, pricing, cooperation history, and contact status.

2. Outreach & Partnership Communication

- Clearly introduce our platform, cooperation model, campaign goals, and content requirements to potential influencers.

- Manage influencer outreach, follow-ups, initial negotiation, cooperation confirmation, and ongoing communication.

- Maintain a professional and friendly communication style to build long-term influencer relationships.

3. Content Production Coordination

- Prepare or assist in preparing campaign briefs, including content direction, key selling points, posting requirements, timelines, and important notes.

- Coordinate with influencers throughout the content production process, including script review, draft feedback, revision follow-up, and final publishing.

- Review influencer content to ensure it aligns with the platform’s positioning, brand tone, campaign goals, and basic quality standards.

- Provide reasonable feedback to improve content quality, clarity, engagement, and conversion potential.

4. Campaign Execution & Project Follow-up

- Follow up on the full influencer cooperation process, from influencer sourcing and outreach to content publishing and data collection.

- Track cooperation progress, identify issues in time, and coordinate with internal teams when needed.

- Help improve influencer cooperation workflows, outreach templates, campaign briefs, and tracking documents.

5. Data Collection & Campaign Review

- Collect and organize campaign performance data, including views, reach, engagement, clicks, registrations, downloads, conversions, and other relevant metrics.

- Analyze the performance of different influencers, content formats, platforms, and campaign strategies.

- Prepare regular campaign summaries and provide suggestions for future optimization.

- Support decisions on whether to continue, renew, or expand cooperation with specific influencers.

6. Content & Social Media Trend Observation

- Stay updated on content trends across major social media platforms, especially in European, North American markets.

- Understand popular content formats, creator styles, and influencer marketing approaches.

- Suggest suitable influencer cooperation directions and content ideas based on platform goals.

- Candidates with social media operation experience may also support basic content planning or promotional content optimization.

7. Team Coordination / Small Team Management, If Applicable

title: Video editor - Social media director
description:
Social Media Director & Video Editor



The Neshamah Institute | Boca Raton, FL (Hybrid/Remote considered) | Part-Time or Contract



About Neshamah



The Neshamah Institute is a dues-free, membership-free, post-denominational Jewish community serving Boca Raton, Delray Beach, and greater Palm Beach County, with online programming reaching people worldwide. Founded in 2010 by Rabbi Amy Rader, Neshamah is a "synagogue without walls," built on the belief that Jewish life should be accessible, warm, and free from barriers to entry.



We tell stories. A lot of them. Across a growing slate of original video series for kids, teens, and adults, weekly email content, and a robust social media presence, Neshamah is one of the most content-active small Jewish organizations in the country. We're looking for someone who can help us keep up with ourselves.



The Role



We're seeking a Social Media Director & Video Editor to lead the day-to-day life of Neshamah's digital presence: turning finished scripts and raw footage into polished, publishable video content, and running the social media channels where our community lives online.



This is a hands-on production and strategy role. You'll be working from scripts, series bibles, and SEO packages that are already built, so your job is execution, consistency, and creative judgment, not starting from a blank page every time.



What You'll Do



Video Editing & Production





Edit short-form video content for multiple ongoing series (children's Torah study, holiday programming, Shabbat music content, congregant interviews, and more)

Work from existing scripts, shot lists, and designer handoff briefs to bring each episode to life

Maintain visual consistency across series: title cards, lower thirds, sign-off graphics, and brand colors

Manage a regular production and publishing calendar across multiple concurrent series

Organize and archive raw footage, project files, and final exports





Social Media Management





Own day-to-day posting and community management across Neshamah's social platforms

Adapt long-form video content into platform-native short-form cuts (Reels, Shorts, TikTok-style edits)

Draft captions, hashtags, and post copy aligned with each series' established voice and sign-off lines

Monitor engagement, respond to comments and messages, and flag opportunities or concerns to Rabbi Amy

Track performance metrics and report on what's resonating, so we can do more of it





Collaboration





Work closely with Rabbi Amy and the Neshamah team to understand upcoming series, events, and priorities

Coordinate with designers, volunteers, and outside contributors as needed

Help maintain brand consistency across video, social, and web content





What We're Looking For





Demonstrated experience editing video for social platforms (portfolio or reel required)

Comfort managing multiple content series and deadlines at once

Strong eye for pacing, captioning, and platform-specific formatting (vertical video, text overlays, hooks)

Self-directed and organized. You'll be handed scripts and briefs, not detailed shot-by-shot instructions

Familiarity with or willingness to learn the rhythms of Jewish communal life and calendar (holidays, Shabbat, lifecycle events)

Experience with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, Canva, or similar

Bonus: experience with GoHighLevel, Yoast SEO, or nonprofit/synagogue communications





Why Neshamah



You'll be joining an organization that treats storytelling as core to its mission, not an afterthought. Our content isn't filler between events. It's how thousands of people who will never walk through a physical building experience Jewish community. You'll have real creative ownership, a library of established series and brand assets to work within, and a team that moves fast and cares deeply about getting it right.



To Apply



Please send a resume, a portfolio or reel of recent video editing work, and a brief note about why this role interests you to 
 or visit 
.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
As our operation continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced and highly motivated CDL Driver Recruiter who can take ownership of recruiting qualified Class A CDL drivers for our Cleveland, Ohio operation.



The CDL Driver Recruiter will be responsible for managing the full recruiting process for Class A CDL drivers, with a primary focus on maintaining adequate staffing levels for Jahlove Logistics’ Amazon Freight Partner operation\.



The recruiter will actively source candidates, manage job postings, screen applicants, conduct initial interviews, follow up with qualified candidates, coordinate onboarding requirements, and maintain an organized pipeline of drivers ready for hire\.



We are looking for someone who is **proactive and results\-driven**\. This is not a position where the recruiter simply waits for applications\. The successful candidate will actively identify, contact, engage, and recruit qualified CDL drivers\.



## Key Responsibilities



• Recruit qualified Class A CDL drivers for SOLO2 and other Jahlove Logistics driving opportunities\.



• Create, post, maintain, and optimize job advertisements across recruiting platforms and other effective driver\-recruiting channels\.



• Actively source CDL drivers through job boards, driver databases, social media, referrals, and direct outreach\.



• Respond quickly to new applicants and maintain consistent communication throughout the hiring process\.



• Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews\.



• Verify basic qualifications including CDL status, driving experience, work history, availability, and ability to meet company and Amazon Freight Partner requirements\.



• Coordinate the hiring process, including background checks, MVR reviews, DOT physical requirements, drug screening, and onboarding documentation\.



• Maintain an organized recruiting pipeline and accurately track candidates through each stage of the hiring process\.



• Follow up with candidates who begin but do not complete the application or onboarding process\.



• Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified drivers so hiring needs can be addressed quickly as additional tractors and routes become available\.



• Work closely with Jahlove Logistics leadership and operations management to understand current and upcoming staffing requirements\.



• Provide regular recruiting updates including applicants, interviews, qualified candidates, pending onboarding, hires, and recruiting challenges\.



• Identify recruiting trends and recommend changes to job postings, sourcing strategies, compensation messaging, or recruiting channels when necessary\.

title: Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor



Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2-3 of your best short-form content edits

- What AI tools have you used before?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If one of your videos significantly underperformed compared to the others, how would you figure out what went wrong and improve the next one?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): Tell us about something you taught yourself without being asked. How did you learn it?

- Your timezone + working hours

No portfolio = no review.

title: Social Media Content Creator and Director
description:
Social Media Director (Part-Time, Remote, Contract)

The Neshamah Institute | 
 | Based in Boca Raton, Florida, USA | Open to applicants worldwide



About Us

The Neshamah Institute is a dues-free, membership-free, post-denominational Jewish community serving South Florida in person and people worldwide online. Founded in 2010 by Rabbi Amy Rader, Neshamah is built on radical inclusivity, personal relationships, and accessible Jewish life. Our online presence is one of the main ways new people find us, and we are ready to grow it.



The Role

We are looking for a creative, organized, and reliable Social Media Director to manage our posting calendar and grow our online audience and engagement, with a special focus on TikTok. Some of the content already exists: we have a large library of finished video series (including Parshah Scoop, The Torah Boss, 18 Sparks for Shabbat, Seasons of Life, and Two Jews, Three Opinions) ready to be scheduled. Your job is to post it consistently, create supporting static and video posts, and help us learn what works.The job also includes creating new content based on the details below.



Content Focus

Our social media centers on three areas:



Event promotion and recaps (our main focus). Promoting Shabbat services, holiday celebrations, and mitzvah projects, then sharing event recaps using real photos and video clips from our community gatherings.



Jewish education. Promoting our three education departments: adult learning, Hebrew School, and our B'nai Mitzvah program, 

showing families and adults the learning opportunities Neshamah offers.



Lifecycle services. Promoting Rabbi Amy and Neshamah as a home for Jewish lifecycle moments, including wedding officiating, baby namings, and funerals.



Platforms

, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and YouTube (including Shorts).



Responsibilities



Manage and maintain our monthly posting calendar (approximately 60 posts per month across platforms)



Schedule existing video series according to the established calendar, using US Eastern Time



Create original static graphics and short-form video posts (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) using our brand colors and style



Create event promotion posts and edit event photos and video clips into engaging recap posts



Adapt content for each platform's format, captions, hashtags, and best practices



Lead TikTok growth: trends, hooks, captions, posting times, and experimentation



Follow a clear content creation and review process so every post is checked for accuracy, spelling, links, and tone before it goes live



Submit posts for Rabbi Amy's approval according to our approval workflow before publishing



Monitor comments and messages, flagging anything sensitive or requiring a pastoral or rabbinic response



Check in daily with a brief progress update (a quick message is fine)



Meet weekly with Rabbi Amy by video call to review upcoming content and recent performance



Prepare a short monthly metrics report (reach, followers, engagement, top posts, TikTok growth) with recommendations for the next month



Required



Proven experience managing social media for a business, nonprofit, or creator account (please share examples)



Fluent, natural-sounding written English suited to a US audience



Strong skills in a design and video editing tool such as Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Express



Ability to turn raw event photos and video clips into polished recap posts



A clear, organized process for creating, reviewing, and scheduling content



Attention to detail and reliability with deadlines



Comfort receiving feedback and working within an approval process



Reliable internet connection and your own computer and software



Availability for a short daily check-in and a weekly video meeting 



Respect for Jewish community values and sensitivity to religious content



Preferred



Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) social planner for scheduling



Proven TikTok growth experience



Experience working with US-based clients or audiences



Experience with nonprofit, faith-based, education, or wedding and event accounts



Basic understanding of SEO for YouTube and Google Business Profile



Details



Location: Fully remote, open to applicants worldwide



Schedule: Flexible hours. We estimate roughly 10 hours per week.



Compensation: $150 to $175 USD per month, based on experience, paid via PayPal on the last day of each month



Pay increase review at 3 month point.



Structure: Independent contractor. Begins with a one-month paid trial, then continues month to month if it's a good fit for both sides. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes in their country.



Communication: Daily brief check-in via WhatsApp, weekly video meeting with Rabbi Amy, monthly metrics review



Content ownership: All content created for Neshamah belongs to The Neshamah Institute



Privacy: Some community content involves families and children. You'll follow our photo consent and privacy guidelines and keep all community information confidential.



How to Apply



Please send:

A short note about your experience and why this role interests you



Links to 2 to 3 accounts or posts you've managed or created

title: Merchandise Planner (WSSI / OTB), Australian Fashion Brand, Full-Time
description:
Do you like tidying up messy data until it tells you what to buy? A growing Australian womenswear brand, selling through ecommerce, wholesale and marketplaces in both hemispheres, is looking for a Merchandise Planner to own its numbers. You'll run the weekly sales, stock and intake (WSSI) and the open-to-buy (OTB), and you'll build the planning systems the brand needs as it grows.



This role is for someone who can work on their own. You'll run the weekly planning cycle yourself, bring recommendations to the team before they ask, and build a better tool whenever the current one isn't good enough.



**What you'll do**

- Own the WSSI and OTB end to end, by month, category and channel

- Produce the weekly trading report: sales vs plan and last year, sell-through, best and worst sellers, and weeks cover

- Analyse stock and sell-through by category, colour, price point, channel and region

- Recommend replenishment, reorders, recuts and markdowns, with the reasoning behind each

- Support range planning with option plans, category mix and buy budgets

- Track purchase orders, supplier deliveries and intake against the plan

- Pull, clean and reconcile raw data from the inventory system, Shopify and spreadsheets

- Build reporting templates, dashboards and documented processes from scratch



**Must-haves**

- 3+ years in merchandise planning or allocation in fashion or retail

- Hands-on experience running a WSSI and an OTB (owning them, not just updating them)

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH and SUMIFS

- Experience working with raw exports from Shopify and/or an ERP or inventory system

- Strong commercial understanding: sell-through, weeks cover, margin and markdown

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Able to work Australian (Sydney) business hours, Monday to Friday. From 4 October, when Sydney's daylight saving starts, this is about 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time

- A reliable computer, a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work



**Nice-to-haves**

- Power Query, Power BI or Looker Studio

- Cin7, NetSuite or a similar inventory system

- Womenswear or DTC fashion experience across ecommerce and wholesale

- Planning across more than one region or season calendar

- Using AI tools to speed up data cleaning and analysis

**Why join**

- A long-term, full-time role with a fashion brand that's growing

- Real ownership: you'll build the planning function, not just maintain it

- Your recommendations will directly shape what the brand buys, reorders and marks down

- You'll work closely with an experienced merchandise planning lead and a supportive team

- Fully remote, with a clear schedule and great people



**How to apply**

Please put the word **WSSI** in your subject line, so we know you've read the whole ad. Applications without it won't be reviewed.



Include:

1. Your CV

2. A short paragraph (5 to 8 sentences) about a planning system you built or a messy dataset you cleaned up. Tell us what the problem was, what you built or changed, which tools you used, and what it made possible.



We shortlist on that paragraph, so please make it specific.

Nice to have

- Fashion, apparel or footwear e-commerce experience.

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line "Search Term – [Your Name]" and include:

title: SEO MANAGER (ORGANIC SEO ONLY – LONG-TERM ROLE)
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read this carefully before applying. Generic applications will be ignored.



We are an Australian facilities management company with a growing digital footprint across multiple service industries. We are looking for a highly capable Organic SEO Manager to take full ownership of our SEO strategy and execution. This is not a junior role, not a “content poster” role, and not a shortcut or black-hat SEO role.



If you rely on AI alone, spam backlinks, or vague SEO theory, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

You will own organic SEO end-to-end, including strategy, execution, tracking, and results.



• Full SEO audits and ongoing optimisation of existing websites

• Keyword research focused on commercial intent and local/service SEO

• Content optimisation of existing blogs and service pages (we already have large content libraries)

• Creating SEO briefs and optimisation instructions (not just writing content)

• Technical SEO basics: site structure, indexing, crawl issues, Core Web Vitals awareness

• Backlink strategy focused on quality, relevance, and safety (no PBNs, no spam)

• Monitoring performance via Google Search Console and Analytics

• Clear monthly reporting showing what moved, why it moved, and what’s next



You are expected to think, not just execute tasks.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• Not social media

• Not paid ads

• Not AI-generated bulk content without human SEO logic

• Not micromanaged



We care about rankings, traffic quality, and conversions, not vanity metrics.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Only apply if you meet ALL of the following:



• 3+ years hands-on organic SEO experience

• Proven ranking results for competitive or service-based keywords

• Strong keyword research skills (you must understand search intent, not just volume)

• On-page SEO expertise (titles, headings, internal linking, content optimisation)

• Comfortable using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Experience with WordPress or similar CMS

• Ability to explain SEO decisions clearly in English



If you cannot explain why something works, you are not ready for this role.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED BUT HIGHLY VALUED)

• Local SEO experience (service areas, location pages, Google Business Profiles)

• Experience optimising large existing content libraries

• Basic technical SEO understanding (indexing, crawl paths, site health)

• Experience working with Australian or international clients



WORK SETUP & EXPECTATIONS

• Remote role (Philippines-based)

• Full-time, long-term position

• Results-focused environment

• Direct communication with the company owner

• Clear expectations, no micromanagement



SALARY

Competitive and based on proven ability, not promises. Performance reviews based on measurable SEO outcomes.



HOW TO APPLY (THIS IS IMPORTANT)

To be considered, your application MUST include the following:



A short explanation (in your own words) of how you approach SEO for a service-based business



One example of a website you helped rank, including what you did and what improved



The word “ORGANIC” at the top of your application so we know you read this



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be ignored.



We are looking for someone who wants stability, ownership, and long-term growth, not someone looking for a short-term gig.



If you’re confident in your SEO skills and want to be judged on results, we want to hear from you.

title: High-Ticket Enrollment Closer
description:
We are hiring 10 proven high-ticket closers.



We are a science-based relationship transformation company. Our clients are financially successful

women (founders, executives, physicians, attorneys) who have built everything except the partnership they want. Our methodology helps them identify and clear the patterns standing in

the way. Our enrollment conversations are deep, discreet and high-trust. They are also high-ticket.



This role is for a hunter. 



You don’t wait for a full calendar. Our setters and AI assistant book qualified calls for you, and you also work a database of approximately 120,000 contacts to find the opportunities everyone else missed. You book them, close them and collect.



Top performers get top leads. Lead access is earned by results. Our most qualified inbound

opportunities go to our highest-level closers.



You must have:



• Completed a recognized high-ticket sales training program, such as SheSells or an equivalent. You’ll tell us which one and show us how you use it.



• A proven record closing high-ticket offers of $5,000 or more on consultative calls. Bring your

numbers: calls taken, close rate and cash collected.



• Self-starter drive. You prospect, book and close in the same role.



• The integrity to qualify hard. We would rather lose a sale than enroll the wrong client.



• Disciplined CRM habits and an appetite for coaching: daily role-play, recorded calls and weekly call

review.



• Speed. New leads hear from you within minutes, not hours.



• Strongly preferred: experience selling to women, or in coaching, wellness or personal development.



How you’ll be paid:



• Months 1–3 (ramp): 10% commission on cash collected, plus any wages required by law.



• Weekly bonuses from week one: hit $50,000, $75,000, $100,000 or $150,000 in upfront cash in a

week and earn a $250 to $2,000 bonus, plus surprise rewards for top performers.



• Weekly ramp targets: Month 1, $40,000 collected. Month 2, $70,000. Month 3, $100,000, with 15

qualified bookings.



• Hit your ramp and you enter our 12-level Closer Ladder: a monthly base that grows at every level,

plus 10–12% commission that never goes down as you climb.



• At our $100,000-a-week target (Level 7), plan pay is about $50,800 a month. Our top level pays a

$15,000 monthly base plus 12% commission.



• Leadership track: lead a pod of closers for an override, then move into Sales Manager at a $100,000 base plus 1% of your team’s collected cash.



How we promote:



Every month, on your trailing 12-week results: collected cash, qualified bookings, show rate, chargeback

rate and CRM quality. No politics and no tenure clock. Produce, and you move up.



To apply:



Send your résumé, the name of the high-ticket program you completed, and your last 90 days of results

(calls, close rate and cash collected, with no client names). Shortlisted candidates complete a live

discovery-and-close role-play.

title: SEO Strategist
description:
HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, you must apply directly through our hiring portal using this link:





WHO WE ARE

Spark Marketing Agency is a fast growing digital marketing firm dedicated to scaling home service contractors across the US. We utilize data driven advertising, local SEO, and in house media production to build predictable revenue engines for our clients. Our commitment to operational excellence and real ROI over vanity metrics has allowed us to deliver measurable growth and keep our clients winning month after month. We are focused on turning ad spend into signed contracts while building a team of highly accountable, top tier professionals.



THE ROLE

You are the lead SEO strategist overseeing organic search performance across the entire agency, with a heavy emphasis on Local SEO and Google Business Profiles (GBP). You sit above our content writers and junior SEO teams and own rankings, traffic, and organic lead generation across 150+ contractor accounts.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Oversee all client SEO campaigns (on-page, off-page, technical, and local). Catch ranking drops before clients do. You own the outcome when a site loses visibility and know how to recover it.

* Set the agency standards for site architecture, local schema markup, keyword mapping, citation building, and GBP optimization.

* Train and coach junior SEOs and content creators. Review their optimization work weekly. Tell them what to change and why. Make them better every month.

* Run Spark's own SEO strategy to acquire new clients. This account directly funds the agency and gets your best work.

* Read Google Search Console and GA4 reports to diagnose what is actually broken technically or content-wise, not just what automated third-party audit tools say.

* Understand lead quality, not just traffic volume. You know the difference between ranking for a high-intent "plumber near me" keyword that books jobs and a national informational blog post that only inflates vanity traffic.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* Deep, proven mastery in Local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization, local service area pages, map pack rankings, and local link building). This is the absolute priority for this role.

* 3+ years managing SEO on the agency side, not client side.

* Real, proven experience driving organic leads for home services or contractor client accounts (plumbing, roofing, HVAC, remodeling, etc.). This is not negotiable. Ecommerce, info products, and SaaS experience do not transfer here.

* Track record of managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without letting smaller ones suffer.

* Deep comfort with technical SEO, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and WordPress architectures.

* Ability to audit site structures, identify indexing issues, and diagnose algorithmic penalties quickly.

* Prior experience training, reviewing, or managing other SEO specialists or writers.

* Clear, direct communication in writing and on calls. No scripts needed.

* Reliable internet and a computer that can handle a full workday.

* Commitment to working 9 a.m. PST to 6 p.m. PST (this is overnight in the Philippines and parts of Asia).



NICE TO HAVE

* Solid working knowledge of Google Ads and how paid and organic search integrate.

* Experience with GoHighLevel CRM and website builders.

* Prior work with programmatic SEO or advanced local landing page automation at scale.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

* Someone who only knows how to run automated SEO audit tools and blindly exports PDF reports for clients.

* Someone who relies on spammy, outdated link-building tactics (PBNs, exact match anchor text stuffing) that put our clients' domains at risk.

* Someone who needs daily check ins or constant hand holding.

* Someone who blames Google core updates or algorithm shifts and throws their hands up when rankings drop.



We want someone who owns the organic number.



LOGISTICS

Full time independent contractor role, remote. You must be able to work from 9 a.m. PST to 6 p.m. PST reliably. Compensation is based on experience and demonstrated contractor account management at scale.

title: STR Guest Experience Specialist
description:

Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–4:00 PM ET | Remote | $7–$9/hour

Exhale Vacation Rentals is a boutique short-term rental management company based in Palm Beach County, Florida. We manage a curated portfolio of high-end vacation rentals and pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional experience for our guests and homeowners.



We are a small, fast-moving team where everyone plays an important role in keeping the business running smoothly.

This is not a passive role and there is very little downtime. These are our busiest operational hours. You will be actively coordinating with guests, homeowners, vendors, property managers, and our field team throughout the day.



Your day could involve dispatching a plumber, troubleshooting an AC issue with a guest, ordering supplies, coordinating a delivery, helping a maintenance team member solve a problem, or finding a solution to an unexpected issue.

We value career growth and stability. If your résumé shows that you have been promoted or taken on increasing responsibility within the same company, please highlight that. A history of earning promotions is a strong indicator of the type of ownership and work ethic we are looking for.



Previous experience in business operations, hospitality, property management, vacation rentals, or a similar environment is preferred.



Experience with Airbnb, OwnerRez, Breezeway, Slack, Asana, or Google Workspace is a plus.

title: Senior E-Commerce Video Editor & Creative Strategist (AI + Performance Ads)
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

We are looking for an experienced E-Commerce Video Editor & Creative Strategist to work with multiple brands and products on an ongoing basis.

This is not an entry-level position.

Please DO NOT APPLY if you do not have at least 3–5 years of relevant editing experience, including proven experience creating video ads for e-commerce brands, DTC brands, or dropshipping businesses.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use AI tools or generate basic AI videos. We need someone who understands creative strategy, performance advertising, e-commerce, customer psychology, and how to turn an idea into a polished ad that is ready to be tested on platforms such as Meta.

You should be comfortable working across many different creative concepts and formats, including:

- UGC-style video ads

- Direct-response / performance ads

- AI-generated video and B-roll

- AI-assisted UGC

- Pixar-style / 3D animation concepts

- Product demonstrations

- Problem/solution concepts

- Storytelling and advertorial-style creatives

- Hooks and multiple ad variations

- Static image ads

- Other creative formats depending on the product and target audience

AI experience is required. You should already be comfortable working with modern AI image/video tools and know how to combine AI with professional editing to create convincing, high-quality commercial content.

WHAT WE EXPECT

You need to be highly creative and independent.

We do not want to explain every scene, transition, visual, hook, or piece of B-roll to you.

When you receive a product, brief, script, or idea, we expect you to research the product, understand the target customer and market, study relevant competitors/ads when necessary, and develop strong creative ideas yourself.

You should be able to look at a product and think:

“What angles can we test? What hooks could stop this audience? What creative formats make sense for this product? How can I turn this into an ad worth testing?”

We want someone who actively brings ideas to the table instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.

You should also understand that a beautiful video is not necessarily a good advertisement. The objective is to create high-quality creatives designed to generate sales and be tested for performance.

IMPORTANT — DO NOT APPLY IF:

Please do not apply if:

- You have less than 3 years of relevant professional experience.

- Your portfolio mainly consists of random AI generations, personal experiments, generic animations, or non-commercial projects.

- You have little or no experience creating ads for e-commerce/DTC brands.

- You depend heavily on ChatGPT/Claude or AI tools to tell you what to create.

- You need detailed instructions for every scene.

- You cannot independently research a product and its target audience.

- You have never worked with multiple advertising concepts and formats.

- You cannot show real, relevant e-commerce advertising work in your portfolio.

Knowing how to operate AI software is not the same as being an experienced creative editor.

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to combine editing + AI + advertising + creative strategy + e-commerce into one complete workflow.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

When applying, please include:

1. How many years have you professionally edited e-commerce/performance advertising?

2. Which e-commerce/DTC brands or products have you worked with?

3. Send 3–5 of your BEST e-commerce video ads. Do not send your entire portfolio.

4. Which AI video/image tools do you currently use professionally?

5. Briefly explain your role in the examples you send. Did you develop the concept yourself, or were you given exact instructions?

6. Have any of your creatives generated measurable sales or been scaled by a client? If yes, briefly explain. Please do not invent performance numbers.

7. Start your application with the word “NOVA”. Applications that do not start with NOVA will not be considered.

That last requirement is intentional. It immediately removes many people who mass-apply without even reading the job description.

PAID TEST

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical editing test.

The test will be based on the type of work you would actually be doing with us.

Passing the test is required before moving forward. A strong portfolio alone does not guarantee the position.

We will evaluate:

Creative thinking • Editing quality • E-commerce understanding • AI execution • Attention to detail • Ability to work independently • Communication • Final ad quality

COMPENSATION

Starting rate: $3–$4 USD/hour

There will also be a performance-based bonus structure tied to the results generated by the creatives.

The initial period will be used to evaluate the quality and consistency of your work. If the collaboration performs well and your creatives produce strong results, there will be opportunities to increase the hourly rate and earn additional performance bonuses.

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration, not a one-off editing project.

title: Virtual Assistant -
description:
We are seeking an experienced Prior Authorization Specialist to support a U.S.-based pain management practice.



This is a part-time role focused specifically on obtaining and following up on prior authorizations for pain-management medications. The workload will begin at approximately 5–10 hours per week and may grow as authorization volume increases.



The ideal candidate has direct, verifiable experience completing medication prior authorizations for a U.S. pain-management, specialty, primary-care, behavioral-health, or similar healthcare practice. You must understand how to submit medication authorizations, work through payer portal requirements, obtain supporting clinical documentation, follow up on pending requests, and address denials or requests for additional information.



Responsibilities

Review medication prior-authorization requests for completeness and accuracy.



Submit medication prior authorizations through CoverMyMeds, payer portals, fax, phone, or other payer-required methods.



Review patient information, prescribing provider details, diagnosis codes, medication name, strength, dosage, quantity, days’ supply, refill information, and supporting clinical documentation.



Confirm payer-specific requirements such as formulary status, step therapy, quantity limits, prior treatment history, medical-necessity criteria, and supporting chart notes.



Track submitted authorizations and follow up promptly on pending requests.



Document approvals, denials, authorization numbers, approved medication details, effective dates, expiration dates, quantity limits, and payer reference numbers.



Communicate approval status, denials, requests for additional documentation, and urgent issues to the practice team.



Coordinate collection of supporting clinical records when needed.



Assist with medication prior-authorization denials, resubmissions, reconsiderations, appeals, and peer-to-peer review coordination when assigned.



Prioritize urgent medication requests and authorizations that may interrupt a patient’s treatment.



Maintain accurate, timely, HIPAA-compliant documentation in the EHR/EMR and authorization tracker.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 2 years of direct U.S. healthcare prior-authorization experience.



Confirmed experience handling medication prior authorizations for pain-management patients.



Experience with controlled and non-controlled pain-management medications, formulary restrictions, step therapy, quantity limits, and medical-necessity documentation.



Proficiency with CoverMyMeds and insurance payer portals.



Familiarity with CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, medical terminology, medication dosing, quantity calculations, days’ supply, and prescription-related documentation.



Experience working in a U.S. EHR/EMR and documenting authorization activity accurately.



Strong written and spoken English for communication with insurance representatives, pharmacies, providers, and clinical staff.



Excellent organization, urgency, attention to detail, and follow-through.



Understanding of HIPAA and secure handling of protected health information.



Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a professional workspace.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a pain-management clinic or interventional pain practice.



Familiarity with prior authorizations for non-opioid pain medications, topical therapies, neuropathic pain medications, muscle relaxants, migraine medications, and specialty medications.



Experience responding to payer denials, formulary alternatives, step-therapy requirements, quantity-limit exceptions, reconsiderations, and appeals.



Experience with Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Epic, NextGen, AdvancedMD, Tebra/Kareo, or similar EHR/EMR platforms.



How To Apply

title: AI-Assisted B2B Outreach & Sales Assistant | Part-Time

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

AI SKILLS REQUIRED



You must actively use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools to improve prospect research, qualification, outreach, objection handling, and follow-up workflows.



You must know how to:



• Give AI clear instructions and relevant business context.

• Check research against reliable sources.

• Turn AI drafts into natural, persuasive, personalized English.

• Use AI efficiently without sacrificing accuracy or brand quality.

• Protect confidential business and customer information.



Generic AI-generated messages, invented business details, and unverified claims are not acceptable.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experience moving prospects beyond an initial reply toward a paid order.

• Strong written English and confident communication.

• Good judgment about which businesses fit a premium beauty brand.

• Availability to overlap with US Eastern Time for prospect conversations.



Experience in beauty, fashion, bridal, or retail wholesale is a plus.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



We evaluate prospect quality, meaningful replies, qualified sales opportunities, paid first orders, and repeat orders.



Sending a large number of messages alone is not success. We value relevant outreach, consistent follow-up, and profitable customer relationships.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

• Approximately 15–20 hours per week.

• Hourly base pay plus sales commission, with terms agreed before starting.

• A paid two-week trial to assess research quality, communication, follow-up, and working fit.

title: PART-TIME VIRTUAL ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT + CANVA/SOCIAL MEDIA SUPPORT
description:
Please read the entire job description and complete the asks below!



ABOUT SKYFIT STUDIO



SkyFit Studio is a growing boutique fitness studio based in North Carolina, USA. We offer dance fitness, strength and conditioning, step, sculpt, special events, and community-focused fitness experiences.



I am the owner and currently manage many of the administrative, customer-service, marketing, and operational responsibilities myself. I am looking for a reliable, highly organized Virtual Assistant who will help take recurring tasks off my plate and keep things organized behind the scenes.



This is a part-time, long-term opportunity for the right person.



HOURS



Approximately 5–10 hours per week to start.



The selected candidate will begin with a 30-day paid trial. Hours and responsibilities could increase as the business grows and trust is established.



The business operates on U.S. Eastern Time. You do not need to work the entire U.S. business day, but some overlap with Eastern Time is preferred.



WHAT YOU’LL HELP WITH



CUSTOMER + ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



• Monitor and organize the studio
 inbox

• Respond to routine customer questions using provided templates and FAQs

• Send follow-up
s to new and first-time customers

• Follow up with inactive customers and leads

• Track customer inquiries and flag anything requiring the owner’s attention

• Maintain spreadsheets, forms, customer records, and administrative trackers

• Help keep recurring tasks organized and completed on time

• Maintain and update standard
 templates and FAQs

FITNESS STUDIO ADMINISTRATION

SOCIAL MEDIA + CANVA SUPPORT



I am NOT looking for someone to completely take over my brand or social media strategy. I am looking for someone who can take information, ideas, photos, videos, and direction from me and turn them into polished content.



Responsibilities may include:

Strong Canva skills and a good eye for clean, modern design are highly preferred.

TOOLS YOU MAY USE

• Punchpass

• Meta Business Suite

• Instagram

•

• Online forms and spreadsheets

• Other systems as the business grows



Experience with every tool is NOT required.



Punchpass experience is not required. I am willing to train the right person.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



I am looking for someone who is:



• Extremely organized

• Detail-oriented

• Reliable and consistent

• Proactive

• Comfortable working independently

• A strong written English communicator

• Professional when communicating with customers

• Able to follow written processes, instructions, and checklists

• Comfortable learning new software

• Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

• Able to recognize patterns and suggest improvements

• Able to recognize when something requires the business owner’s attention

• Comfortable asking questions when clarification is genuinely needed

• Able to manage recurring responsibilities without needing constant reminders



I do not want someone who needs to be micromanaged.



I want someone who eventually learns the business well enough to notice things like:



“Three customers asked the same question this week. We should probably update the FAQ.”



or



“This customer has an unusual billing issue. I did not make any changes because this requires owner approval.”



Good judgment is extremely important to me.



BONUS EXPERIENCE

SECURITY + ACCOUNT ACCESS

title: DIRECTOR OF OPS AND FINANCE
description:
THE ROLE



Your job in one sentence: protect revenue.



You own the financial and operational outcome of the business. Your job is to run cash, inventory, and fulfillment so well that the founder never has to step into ops or finance, because every hour he spends there is an hour not spent on product and marketing, which is where the company grows.



Your score is one number: Total Operational Loss, the sum of the three costs you control. Cancels caused by lead times, shipping to customers, and freight to the USA including reships and replacement parts. Every week you predict it, then beat your prediction.



This is not a reporting role. Reports are the exhaust of the job, not the job. You plan what gets paid and when, you keep inventory landing before we stock out and after we can afford it, you push suppliers and the 3PL when they slip, and you bring the founder decisions with your recommendation attached, not problems without options.



You will work daily with the founder, our systems lead, our payments coordinator, our CS team, our 3PL, and our factories.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN: FINANCE



--> The 25-week rolling cash flow model: multi-scenario, assumption-driven, synced to the inventory tracker, with every week's low point visible before it arrives



--> Bill payments: you d
 and dictate what gets paid, when, and what gets pushed or negotiated. You issue the weekly payment sheet that the team executes wires from. The founder approves in one look on Slack. Nobody plans payments but you, and no bill moves off your schedule without you flagging what it does to the projection



--> Loan and financing management: Shopify Capital, Wayflyer, supplier terms, including modeling repayment schedules before we sign, not after



--> Supplier payment negotiation: deposits, Net terms, and holding suppliers to the projection instead of quietly absorbing their timing



--> Sales and demand modeling: regressions on Shopify data to size orders and set revenue expectations



--> Cash turnover and downside scenarios: what comes back each week when we sell, and what breaks at 85 percent of plan



--> Sales tax, duties, and tariff tracking with our accountants





WHAT YOU WILL OWN: OPERATIONS



--> Inventory planning end to end: factory orders sized and timed against runway, ocean freight booked at lowest landed cost, containers mapped to warehouses, the inventory tracker kept live



--> Supplier management: quotes, POs, deposits, production follow-ups, and escalating when a factory or vendor goes quiet



--> 3PL performance: receiving events checked in on time, priority orders shipped inside 48 hours, backorder allocation, and daily escalation when they slip



--> Fulfillment economics and trade-off math: sometimes spending more in one column saves the total, like shipping only from Arizona at higher cost to cut lead times when the cancels prevented cost more than the extra shipping. Every recommendation comes with cost added per order and cost per day saved



--> CS operations interface: allocation of constrained stock, cancel-rate reduction tied to lead times, and keeping the cancel backlog shrinking. You answer five questions cold, without opening a file: are we gaining or losing days of stock, how is ship-to-customer trending, how is landed cost trending, how are cancels trending, and how are we preserving revenue across all four



--> Freight quotes and duty planning for every inbound container





HOW YOU WILL WORK



--> AI-first for systems, manual for accountability: every workflow runs through Claude before the old way, and if AI cannot do something you try at least 20 approaches before calling it blocked. But your weekly numbers and your "what I am doing about it" are typed by you, in your own words. Automated AI reports do not get read and do not get felt. You have to physically know your numbers.



--> Done means excellent, shipped, and visible. "Almost done" is not a status. Work the founder never sees did not happen.



--> Weekly cadence: Tuesday morning review call (ops, finance, CS) where you present. Friday written recap of what shipped, hours saved, experiments running, and what you need.



--> Decisions travel with options: when you are stuck, you bring what you tried, the choices, and your recommendation. Never a problem without options.



--> Numbers get verified to source. A model is checked against the bank balance, the loan offer sheet, and the tracker before anyone d
 on it. Errors get documented so they are not repeated.



--> You push back out loud. When a supplier, a bill, or a teammate breaks the plan, you flag it the day it happens instead of silently adjusting the model.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-haves:



--> 3+ years running ops or finance for an ecommerce or DTC brand with physical inventory: you have placed factory orders, booked ocean freight, and lived through a cash crunch



--> Strong spreadsheet modeling: you can build a driver-based cash flow model with live formulas, defend every number in it, and find the broken sum in someone else's



--> Supplier and 3PL management experience, including uncomfortable negotiations over terms and timing



--> Daily, fluent AI use: you already work with Claude or similar tools and can show something real you built with them



--> Excellent written English: most decisions here happen in Slack, in short clear writing



--> Ownership and strategic proactivity: you have run a function where the outcome was yours, not just the tasks. The bar here is manager, not assistant: you see the big picture and arrive at the problems yourself, before anyone names them for you



You are not a fit if:



--> You need detailed instructions before starting, or wait to be unblocked instead of trying another way



--> Your instinct when a number is off is to adjust quietly rather than raise it



--> You prefer deep work in private over showing unfinished work early



--> You see AI as a threat or a shortcut rather than the way the job is done





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days: you know every supplier, loan, container, and payment by name and can answer the five questions cold. You run the weekly payment plan and the Tuesday review without help. Your Total Operational Loss scorecard is
 the number, the three columns, your prediction, and what you are doing about it, every Friday. The cash flow model is verified to source and you have found at least one thing wrong with it.



By 60 days: inventory orders are placed on your recommendation. The founder approves your plans in one look instead of building them with you. The operational efficiency score is reported weekly and climbing.



By 90 days: the founder has not been pulled into an ops or finance fire for a month. Cash low points are flagged weeks ahead with options attached. You have systematized at least three recurring workflows with AI and can show the hours saved.





COMPENSATION



--> Salary: USD 2,500 per month, full time, remote



--> Hours: substantial overlap with US Eastern mornings required for the weekly review and founder calls



--> Performance upside: team members who own outcomes share in company-wide incentive pools when we win



--> Tools provided: Claude, Slack, Google Workspace, Shopify, and whatever else the job needs





HOW TO APPLY



Send the following. Applications missing any item will not be read.



1. A short note on the hardest cash or inventory decision you have owned: the numbers, what you chose, and what happened



2. One spreadsheet model you built yourself, with a paragraph on how you verified it



3. One concrete example of a workflow you automated or ran with AI, with before and after



4. Your earliest available start date

title: Executive Assistant & Client Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

You’ll be the operating backbone for the company’s leadership team. The largest part of the job is classic executive support: calendars, meetings, inboxes, and follow-through for the company’s two co-founders. The second part is coordinating how new clients get started, so the customer success team can spend its time with clients instead of chasing calendars. You will be a working member of the team, not a task queue. You will learn how the company operates and get to know the clients.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Executive and leadership support

• Own the calendars for both co-founders: schedule, reschedule, protect focus time, and resolve conflicts across time zones.

• Coordinate meetings with clients, prospects, partners, investors, and vendors, including sending invites, confirming attendees, and sharing agendas and materials ahead of time.

• Triage and draft
 responses, keep follow-ups from slipping, and track open action items after meetings.

• Prepare meeting briefs and pull together notes, summaries, and next steps from recorded calls.

• Over time, extend the same support to other members of the leadership team.



2. Client kickoff and project coordination

• When a new client signs, run the kickoff logistics, identify the key people on the client side and on the company side, and make sure everyone knows their role.

• Send intake surveys and questionnaires to new clients to gather details about their company, team, and goals, then follow up until they are complete.

• Work with each client to map out their onboarding meeting plan: which sessions are needed, what each one covers, when it should happen, and who needs to attend.
