• Follow up with clients after each meeting: send recaps and next steps, and chase open items, surveys, and action items until they are done.

• Take the bulk of scheduling work off our customer success lead so he can stay focused on the client relationship.

• Keep simple, accurate records of where each client is in onboarding and flag anything that is stuck.



3. Internal operations

• Help with general internal coordination beyond calendars and
, such as tracking product activation for new clients, organizing shared files, and keeping team documentation current.

• Spot repeat work and suggest better ways to handle it.

• Pick up ad hoc projects as the company grows.



Requirements

• 3+ years as an executive assistant, project coordinator, operations coordinator, or similar role supporting senior leaders.

• Strong command of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook calendar and
, Teams, and SharePoint.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will write directly to our clients, who are business owners and technology leaders in the US.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling many moving pieces for several people at once.

• Proactive. You follow up without being asked and raise problems early.

• Sound judgment with confidential information.

• Able to work consistently during US Eastern business hours.



Nice to Have

• Experience at a startup or small, fast-moving company.

• Experience coordinating client onboarding or implementation projects at a software, SaaS, or IT services company.

• Familiarity with the MSP or IT services industry.

• Experience with project or ticket tracking tools (we use Linear) and meeting recording tools (we use Avoma).



Tools

🎃 Halloween = new variation

title: AI Operations Lead — Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)
description:
We're a group of four companies, and we're hiring one exceptional person to run operations across all of them with AI tools. You will build and operate the systems that enable each company to run efficiently; you will not replace the functional managers or assume responsibility for their people management.

ARC Group - in-office BPO teams (10+) for mid-sized US companies. No onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

ARC Remote - managed remote staffing for US small businesses.

Kipkeh Media - a WhatsApp media channel for the Orthodox Jewish community.

SetCo / 
 - business entity-formation services.

You report directly to the founder. You'll work closely with our Chief of Staff, she builds the structures, systems, and trusted ground operations; you bring AI-powered execution, optimization, and intelligence. Complementary strengths, not a hierarchy. 

CORE OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Read this carefully: this is a job for a human being who is exceptionally good at using AI tools. Not "uses ChatGPT sometimes." You take entire workflows, lead generation, performance reporting, content planning, billing, invoicing, follow-ups and rebuild them so one person with the right AI stack does what used to take a team. 

However, AI is a means, not the objective.

Impact over tools: We are not automating for automation’s sake. Every system you build must improve revenue, speed, accuracy, cost, visibility, or operational capacity.

Build before you automate: You don’t automate broken processes. First understand the business objective, map the workflow, identify failure points, simplify the process, and then automate what should be automated.

Human judgment: You know when NOT to automate. You understand where human judgment, client relationships, management decisions, and executive judgment must remain human.

AUTHORITY & ESCALATION

You are expected to independently identify problems, recommend solutions, and implement approved operational improvements. You may modify systems and workflows within your area of ownership, but significant changes affecting clients, staffing, pricing, contractual commitments, or company-wide processes require founder approval.

PRIORITIES, IN ORDER

ARC Group pipeline. This is the money. Build the machine that fills it.

ARC Remote running without the founder. Systematize it until he only shows up for relationships and closes.

Kipkeh operations. Money workflow, creator direction, performance intelligence.

NewLLC - automations & processes. Set up the automations and processes alongside the Chief of Staff, so we can hire an admin who handles client relations, billing, filing, and account management and upsells clients into ARC Remote and Kipkeh.

THE MANDATE

Process & SOP Automation - Automate, and continuously improve operational workflows within your assigned areas if necessary. Coordinate with the Chief of Staff and functional owners before materially changing established business processes.

Data & AI Responsibility - You will work with sensitive business, client, employee, and candidate information. You must use approved tools, follow company data-handling rules, and never upload confidential information into an AI platform without authorization.

Marketing - our highest-leverage early win (see below).

Sales support - pipeline tracking, follow-up systems, proposal/invoice workflows. (Closing stays with the founder.)

Recruitment - help hire the roles behind you: screening support, structured interview workflows, candidate tracking.

Management oversight (systems, not people) - build the intelligence layer our managers run on: dashboards, underperformance alerts, KPI tracking, staffing-ratio models. You make problems visible early with data. You do NOT have performance conversations or manage anyone's motivation - when your systems flag a problem, you bring the data to the manager or founder, and they handle the human side.

Systems - design workflows that don't break: edge cases handled, handoffs clean, documented.

Data & reporting - turn raw, messy operational data into decisions. Daily numbers, weekly what's-working analysis, forecasts.

Content operations & direction - direct our on-camera creator with data-backed briefs: what to film, when, and why.

Billing, invoicing, payment tracking - build the money workflow from zero and run it.

Keep up & be ahead - your AI stack is never stale. You bring us tools and methods before we know we need them.

YOUR FIRST BIG WIN: BUILD OUR MARKETING ENGINE

Our Chief of Staff currently runs a small
 lead-gen motion for ARC Group - personally sending 50–100
s, no sequences, no A/B testing. It's time-consuming and going nowhere. The stack is already paid for: Google Workspace + Instantly + Apollo + NeverBounce.

Your job: turn it into a real pipeline machine. Target: 500+
s/week with proper sequences, A/B testing, AI-assisted personalization, tracked follow-ups, and a dashboard the founder can read in 60 seconds. You'll also run the support system behind the founder's LinkedIn outreach, which activates alongside this plan.

Who we're selling to: 50–250 employee companies in three verticals - logistics / freight / supply chain, medical offices (healthcare back-office), and voice agents (customer support / call centers). The offer: in-office BPO teams, no onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

This is how we land our next BPO clients, and it's the single highest-leverage thing you can do in your first 60 days.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

The pipeline machine. List building from the ICP, Instantly sequences, A/B tests, reply triage, follow-up automation, weekly pipeline dashboard. The engine runs; you report the numbers.

ARC Remote, systematized. Map everything the founder does personally; pull it off his plate one workflow at a time. Goal: it runs day-to-day without him.

The money workflow. Advertiser roster, rate sheet, invoices generated from published logs, overdue tracking with follow-up drafts, a Monday money dashboard.

Direct our on-camera creator. He shoots; you think. Turn weekly view data into specific daily shoot briefs backed by numbers, not vibes.

Performance intelligence. Daily view-curve reports from our frame logs. Flag underperforming posts within hours. One-page weekly "what's working" analysis that drives next week's plan.

Management intelligence systems. The dashboards, alerts, and KPI tracking our team leads and account managers run on. You build the visibility; managers handle the people.

Founder's daily digest. One morning briefing: yesterday's numbers, today's plan, decisions needed.

MUST-HAVES

Real, demonstrable AI-tool expertise across: LLMs (advanced prompting, custom assistants/agents), spreadsheet automation (complex formulas, Apps Script or equivalent), data analysis, and workflow automation (Zapier / Make / n8n or similar). We test this live - claims without proof don't pass.

You've built reports or dashboards from raw, messy data before.

Marketing/lead-gen experience:
 outreach, list building, sequencing, follow-up tracking - or a credible plan to build it fast.

You've built or run a billing/invoicing tracker before - or can design one from zero in the interview.

Strong written English. Clear, brief, structured async communication.

Full-time, Philippines-based. This is a 40-hour/week role on a steady, fixed schedule with US-morning (EST) overlap.

No job stacking, no exceptions: this is your only full-time job. No second jobs, freelance clients, or side gigs that compete for your working hours or attention.

Professional setup: 16GB+ RAM, backup internet and power.

NICE-TO-HAVES

Media or content-operations experience.

Experience with remote teams across time zones.

Familiarity with Orthodox Jewish community norms (modesty and kashrus guardrails apply to our channel) - or a fast learner.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: 30 / 60 / 90

Day 14:
 engine live - 500+/week sending on Instantly with sequences and A/B tests. Baseline bounce and unsubscribe rates are actively tracked. First sprint launched on the ICP; LinkedIn support running. ARC Remote audit done: every founder-touch workflow mapped, first one pulled off his plate. The money workflow started. Trial decision point: performing at band level, or we part ways. 

Day 30:
 engine at full volume - 500+/week sending, 2+ A/B tests run with learnings logged. Focus shifts to quality metrics: positive reply rate, qualified replies, meetings booked, and cost/time per qualified opportunity. Reply triage + follow-up system operating with same-day turnaround; pipeline dashboard live. ARC Remote: founder-touch workflows mapped, first SOPs delivered. Creator working from your briefs; first what's-working analysis delivered.

Day 60: The engine runs on rhythm without babysitting. Weekly experiment cadence with results logged. ARC Remote workflows documented and handed over - tracked by the number of workflows automated and measurable hours/cost/error reduction. Underperformer alerts firing same-day. You're the person who spots what's broken across the companies before anyone else does.

Day 90: ARC Group top-of-funnel runs without founder involvement; ARC Remote operates without him; Kipkeh money workflow and creator direction humming. We're scoping your systems across all four companies.

COMPENSATION

$400–600/week, paid weekly via Wise. Full-time, long-term. Exceptional performers grow fast here - including beyond this band. This is a high-impact role with a growth path across four companies.

Trial terms: the first 2 weeks are a paid trial. You come in at a band based on what you demonstrated in the hiring process and in those 2 weeks you have to show it was real. If you're not performing at your band's level, we part ways fast and fairly.

HOW TO APPLY

Record a 2-minute Loom (screen share): show ONE real workflow you automated with AI tools - before, what you built, after. Real example, not a tutorial.

Complete our test task (we send it after your Loom). The test task is paid - $25 USD via Wise. Candidates who advance to the founder interview receive another $25 USD.

No Loom = no review. We move fast for the right person.

###
 & Administrative Operations

 and CRM systems.

title: commerce Aftersales & Quality Specialist (Supply Chain)
description:
We run a group of fast-growing Shopify fashion stores selling to the US, UK, Europe and Australia. We are a small, close team of 8 and process thousands of orders per month. We are growing fast and now need someone dedicated to making sure every customer receives a product they are happy with.



The role

You own everything that happens after a customer places an order. Your goal is simple: fewer refunds, fewer disputes and better products. You work closely with our CS team and report to our CS Manager.



Your responsibilities



Analyze refunds, complaints and disputes every week and find which products and suppliers cause them

Maintain a supplier scorecard (quality, delivery time, complaints, price)

Report weekly, with a clear recommendation

Communicate with suppliers and agents about quality issues, sizing and delays

Check product photos, samples and size charts after the first sale.

Monitor order tracking and make sure delivery status is correct in Shopify

Support the CS team with product and supplier information during disputes



Requirements



At least 1 years of experience in e-commerce operations, dropshipping, supply chain or aftersales

Experience with Shopify (required)

Strong with Google Sheets or Excel: you like working with data and spotting patterns

Excellent written English; clear and professional with suppliers

Very detail-oriented and able to work independently

Stable internet connection and a quiet workspace

Bonus: experience with Chinese suppliers or sourcing agents, fashion or apparel products, dispute/chargeback handling



What we offer



Long-term, stable full-time position

Starting rate of $4/hour with real growth potential based on your results

Opportunity for a monthly KPI bonus in the future

A direct line to the owners; your input really changes how we work

Growth opportunity as our stores keep scaling



How to apply

Send us:



A short description of your previous roles: what you did for your past employers and how you grew into a position like this one. If possible, tell us who these employers were and roughly how much revenue they made (for example monthly or yearly), so we can understand the scale you are used to working at

Start your application with the words "Quality first" so we know you read the full post

title: Social Video Editor & Content Strategist

Required

title: Junior Project and Onboarding Manager – LinkedIn Specialist

General

title: Property Photography QC & Delivery Coordinator / Virtual Assistant
description:
We’re a UK property photography business looking for a reliable, detail-focused assistant to manage media quality checks, delivery, bookings and client communication.



The most important part of this role is taking responsibility for each job through to completion. You should notice missing images, follow up with our editor, resolve small issues and get the finished job delivered without needing to be chased at every step.



Confident phone communication and excellent clutter/object-removal skills are essential. This is primarily a coordination, quality-control and VA role, with clutter removal and occasional quick revisions. Our editor handles the main photo editing.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CALLING HOMEOWNERS AND SCHEDULING



• Call UK homeowners to arrange photography appointments through Spiro, our booking and delivery portal.

• Speak confidently, clearly and in a friendly, professional manner.

• Confirm property addresses, availability, access arrangements and special instructions.

• Handle scheduling and rescheduling through Spiro and keep booking notes accurate.



2. QUALITY CHECKS, CLUTTER REMOVAL AND DELIVERY



• Check incoming media each morning around 10am UK time and prepare jobs for delivery.

• Use your own judgement to spot distracting clutter and remove it to a high standard. Strong object-removal skills are a major part of this role.

• Check removals closely for visible editing marks, repeated textures, distorted objects and other errors.

• Inspect every image for straight verticals, level horizons, correct perspective, consistent colour and exposure, sharpness and clean editing.

• Check for distracting reflections, visible equipment, unnatural retouching and AI-generated errors.

• Make sure every job includes the expected rooms and ordered media, with no missing files, duplicates or incorrect property details.

• Check floor plans for the correct address, clear labels and obvious issues such as missing doors or inconsistent layouts, using the available photographs and job information.

• Upload, organise and deliver media through Spiro. Experience is helpful, but training can be provided.

• Check delivery links and ensure the final presentation is complete and professional.



3. MANAGING REVISION REQUESTS



• Respond to estate agents’ revision requests through
 and WhatsApp.

• Understand what needs changing, ask clear questions where necessary and take ownership of getting it resolved.

• Complete occasional small or urgent photo revisions yourself to a high standard.

• Send clear instructions to our editor for larger revisions, follow up and check the finished work.

• Replace the correct files and let the client know when the changes are ready.



4.
 AND DAY-TO-DAY ADMINISTRATION



• Monitor
s, respond to routine enquiries and keep outstanding requests moving.

• Maintain accurate booking notes and job statuses.

• Flag urgent issues or anything requiring my decision.

• Provide a short daily handover covering completed jobs, outstanding revisions and upcoming bookings.

• Help with other small administrative tasks related to the business.



5. OCCASIONAL TWILIGHT EDITS



• Create twilight edits using my Higgsfield account when requested, following our examples and quality standards.



REQUIREMENTS



• Confident, clear and easily understood spoken English, alongside strong written English. You must be comfortable calling UK homeowners and communicating professionally with estate agents.

• Excellent clutter and object-removal skills. This is particularly important: please provide before-and-after examples demonstrating clean, convincing results.

• Proven photo-retouching ability, ideally with property photography experience.

• The ability to complete occasional quick photo revisions to a high standard.

• Excellent attention to detail and the judgement to spot clutter, quality issues and missing information independently.

• Strong organisation and follow-through. You take ownership of tasks and keep people updated.

• Reliable availability around 10am UK time, with agreed working hours for calls, messages and revisions.

• A reliable internet connection, suitable computer and a quiet environment for phone calls.

• Willingness to learn Spiro and follow our workflow.



WORKING HOURS AND OPPORTUNITY TO GROW



This is a part-time position, initially around 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with work starting around 10am UK time. The exact schedule will be agreed with the successful applicant.



We currently handle approximately three property jobs per day and have ambitious plans to grow over the coming months. We’re looking for someone who would like to grow with the business, with the potential for increased hours and responsibilities as bookings increase.



Additional hours will be agreed together. There is potential for this to become a full-time role in the future, although this is not guaranteed.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

• Before-and-after examples of your photo editing, particularly clutter and object removal.

• A short voice introduction so we can hear your spoken English.

• Your availability in UK time and expected hourly or monthly rate.

title: Job Opportunity: Instagram Content Designer / Carousel Editor | Remote | Freelance
description:
Are you creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about designing high-quality Instagram content? Then we might be looking for you!



We are Brandshippers, a Dutch e-commerce coaching company that helps entrepreneurs build their own online businesses through bol.com, one of the largest online marketplaces in the Netherlands and Belgium.



We are looking for a talented Instagram Content Designer who can help us create professional, engaging, and visually appealing Instagram content.



Our goal is to strengthen our Instagram presence and create content that reflects our brand identity while educating, inspiring, and engaging our audience.



About the Job



As our Instagram Content Designer, you will be responsible for designing different types of Instagram posts for Brandshippers.



Your work may include:



Instagram carousels consisting of multiple slides that tell a complete story.

Educational and informative posts about e-commerce.

Visual content explaining our coaching programs.

Posts showcasing client results and testimonials.

Other creative content that aligns with our brand identity and target audience.



We will provide the necessary information, copy, and content ideas. Your responsibility will be to transform these materials into professional, visually appealing Instagram posts.



You should be able to work independently, contribute creative ideas, and understand how to present information in a clear and engaging visual format.



3-Week Trial Period



We will start with a three-week trial period to determine whether we are a good fit and whether your work meets our expectations.



During this period, we expect:



4 Instagram posts per week for 3 consecutive weeks.



This means a total of 12 Instagram posts during the trial period.



Please note that an Instagram carousel counts as ONE post, regardless of the number of slides it contains.



For example:



1 single-image post = 1 Instagram post.

1 carousel containing 5 slides = 1 Instagram post.

1 carousel containing 8 slides = 1 Instagram post.



A carousel containing five slides does NOT count as five separate Instagram posts.



We will discuss the different types of content and the weekly content schedule together.



After the trial period, we will evaluate the collaboration and discuss the possibility of working together long-term.



What We're Looking For

Experience designing Instagram content, preferably for businesses, personal brands, or online coaching companies.

Strong skills in Figma, Canva, or similar design software.

Experience creating professional and engaging Instagram carousels.

A strong understanding of branding, typography, color combinations, and visual consistency.

The ability to turn information into creative, well-structured visual content.

The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Good English communication skills.

A positive, proactive attitude and willingness to receive feedback.

Availability to create four Instagram posts per week.



Important: All communication with our team will take place through WhatsApp. You must be comfortable using WhatsApp for communication, feedback, and discussing assignments.



Compensation



Compensation is negotiable and will be discussed based on your experience, skills, and expected rates.



We are open to different pricing arrangements, such as payment per post, per carousel, or a fixed rate for an agreed amount of content.



Please share your expected rates when applying.



What We Offer

Fully remote work.

A clear three-week trial period.

A flexible working arrangement with room for creativity.

Direct and personal communication with our team through WhatsApp.

The opportunity to build a long-term working relationship with Brandshippers.

The possibility to grow alongside our company and take on additional creative responsibilities in the future.

How to Apply



Interested in becoming our Instagram Content Designer?

title: Automation & Growth Engineer (Remote, Long-Term)
Grok Bot Dev Lead (Part-Time, 20 hours per week)
description:
About the opportunity



We are a growing US-based business training and media company, and we are looking for a skilled Grok Bot Development Lead. This role owns the AI bot system that finds, scores, and opens conversations with community and event owners so our team can interview them. The bots find and open. People still make the calls, run the interviews, and teach. You build and run the machine that feeds them.



What you will do



Build and maintain two Grok Bots in a dedicated internal workspace: a Researcher that finds, scores, and tracks prospects, and an Opener that drafts and, after human approval, sends
 and LinkedIn messages. Neither bot ever phones or joins a video call.

Write and maintain the standing orders for each bot, including explicit guard rules covering what each bot must never do, and fail any draft that breaks them.

Enrich and score one assigned prospect group from a targeting blueprint, capturing name, title, organization,
, LinkedIn, phone where available, latest public topic, a verbatim public quote, warm relationship flag, decision maker plus up to two lieutenants, and the events contact. Score zero to five against a published rubric and release only the top tier, roughly twenty organizations for the live test rather than two hundred.

Keep every contact's pipeline stage current in GoHighLevel, from first request through called, booked, interviewed, and closed states. GoHighLevel is the only source of truth. No side spreadsheet.

Wire the GoHighLevel intake form and the group-labeled calendar link so the booking, the prep fields, and the status card all agree, then test the whole flow yourself as a prospect would experience it.

Hold send discipline: daily caps per channel, staggered
 and LinkedIn to the same person, one follow-up and then stop, and an immediate channel freeze plus supervisor alert if bounces or platform warnings spike.

Queue drafts for supervisor approval before sending, log subject, body variant, channel, and result, and bring a weekly short list of which copy to keep and which to retire.

Produce the one-page pre-interview brief the same day a slot books, and send a nightly written note to the supervisor covering asks, replies, bookings, no-shows, and next actions.



Schedule and setup



Hours: 20 hours per week

Working hours: the business operates 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific time. You choose which 20 hours you work inside that window, and you keep the same schedule week to week so the supervisor knows when to expect you. For applicants in the Philippines this is a night shift, roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Manila time

Setup: reliable internet and a dedicated computer for the bot workspace. The approved sending Gmail and an approved test LinkedIn profile are provided. Personal accounts are never used for outreach



Must-have skills and tools



Hands-on experience building and operating AI agents or bots: standing orders, group chats, send queues, connected
 accounts, guard rules

GoHighLevel: pipelines, stages, forms, calendars, contact records

List enrichment and prospect scoring against a written rubric

Writing instructions precise enough for a bot to obey, with a clear line between what it does and what it must not do

 and LinkedIn deliverability fundamentals: sending caps, staggering, follow-up limits, and when to freeze a channel

Ability to follow a tight build brief without redesigning the project

Escalates in writing with a proposed option the same day, not with a verbal debug dump

Strong written English



Nice to have



Direct experience inside Grok Bot workspaces

Gmail deliverability and domain warm-up experience

Experience supporting interview, podcast, or speaker booking outreach



Compensation



USD 650 per month for 20 hours per week.



How to apply

Apply here and Include the words "standing order" in the first line of your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: VEGAS PRO Editor for Compilation Videos - Long-Term
description:
Hi,



I run several compilation channels on YouTube, and I’m looking for a **Sony VEGAS Pro editor** who can learn our workflow and work with us long term.



This is a **part-time, long-term position**, not a one-time or pay-per-project job.



### Position Details



* **Role:** VEGAS Pro Editor for Compilation Videos

* **Pay:** $380/month

* **Payment:** Bi-weekly

* **Workload:** Around 2–3 hours per day on average

* You can work ahead and take free days as long as your assigned videos are completed on time.



### What You'll Be Doing



The editing is straightforward. You’ll receive VEGAS Pro projects containing around **10–15 minutes of videos with approximately 100 clips each**.



Your main tasks are:



1. Review the projects and delete any **risky or unfitting clips** based on our guidelines.

2. Combine **3 or 6 projects into one video** by copying, pasting, and blending the clips together.

3. Select the correct clips based on the requirements of each channel.

4. Download and add some **extra clips from a website**.

5. Render the finished video.

6. Create/update a **Google Sheet** with information about the extra clips used.



The clips are already **cut, cropped, and arranged**, so you won't need to do detailed editing from scratch.



You’ll be provided with a **tutorial/SOP** that explains the workflow and requirements for each channel.



### Apply Only If



* You have experience using **Sony VEGAS Pro**.

* You're looking for a **long-term position**.

* You can understand and communicate well in English.

* You're reliable and can consistently meet deadlines.

* You're willing to learn and follow our workflow carefully.

* You have good judgment when reviewing clips.



Once you understand the workflow, the job is simple and repetitive. We're looking for someone who can eventually work independently and consistently.



### When Applying



Please include the following in your **first message**:



* What version of VEGAS Pro you use

* How many monitors you use for editing

* How much experience you have with VEGAS Pro

* Whether you're comfortable with the **$380/month rate**



**Please do not apply if you have never used VEGAS Pro before.**



We're looking for someone dependable who wants a stable, long-term editing position and is willing to learn and improve with us.
